caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a woman with medium brown skin, standing upright on a dark rectangular base with four wheels. The base is inscribed with the word "ANTIQUES" in yellow capital letters on the front-facing side. The woman wears a short, light blue dress with yellow trim and a green sash tied around her waist. The sleeves and hem of the dress are decorated with brown, feather-like elements. She holds a brown cloth or bundle in her right hand, which is hanging by her side, and her left arm is extended forward with an open palm. She wears brown shoes and a main accessory consisting of a yellow headband adorned with three large feathers in red, green, and orange, standing upright from the top of her head. Her black hair flows down her back. The entire composition is set against a plain, beige background. The artist's signature, "Walter F. Ochtman," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
